item.title: ‘Horrendous error’: Florida couple sues fertility clinic because baby isn’t genetically theirs
item.description: The couple love the baby girl, born in December, and are happy to raise her but feel a “moral and legal responsibility” to find and inform her biological parents, their attorney said.

item.title: LaMonte McLemore, singer and founding member of the 5th Dimension, dies at 90
item.description: McLemore died Tuesday at age 90 at his home in Las Vegas, surrounded by family.

item.title: After 80 years, Minute Maid’s frozen canned juices are getting put on ice
item.description: The Coca-Cola Company says Minute Maid’s frozen juices will be discontinued by April.

item.title: Daily Horoscope for February 05, 2026
item.description: It may be tough to stay on top of things today. Tension could spike with little warning, even with the Moon entering thoughtful Libra. This is due to Mercury squaring unpredictable Uranus at 7:13 am EST, putting diplomacy and change at odds with one another. We may wake seeking fairness, then face frustration that makes it hard to say anything nice. Potential conflict can be avoided by grounding innovative ideas with realistic goals. item.title: Man arrested on assault, firearm charges in connection with double shooting outside CT bar
item.description: Police said he is accused of discharged a firearm in the parking lot of the bar, striking two innocent bystanders.

item.title: Musk vows to put data centers in space and run them on solar power but experts have their doubts
item.description: Scientists and industry experts say Musk faces formidable technical, financial and environmental obstacles.

item.title: Nike faces federal probe over allegations of ‘DEI-related’ discrimination against white workers
item.description: Nike called the subpoena a surprising escalation.

item.title: CIA ends publication of its popular World Factbook reference tool
item.description: The agency announced the decision Wednesday but gave no reason for it.

item.title: UConn women’s basketball earns 60th straight Big East win with 86-40 rout of DePaul
item.description: The UConn women's basketball team earned its 60th straight Big East victory with an 86-40 rout of DePaul in Chicago on Wednesday night.
